fields.summary: Add dark mode support to the web UI
fields.description:
Users have requested dark mode support. The app currently only supports a light theme. We should implement a system-preference-aware dark mode using CSS media queries and CSS custom properties.

Requirements:
- Respect system dark mode preference by default
- Allow manual override via a toggle
- Persist user preference in localStorage

comments.body: +1, many users have requested this in support tickets.
